title: Example 127: a backoff's doubling loop replaced by a guarded shift, proved equal on the record
description: Regression proof (B9, Crosscut, JBMC) of net.terminalvalue.crosscut.retry.Backoff#delayMillis against a closed form guarded by Long.numberOfLeadingZeros, on the record's components, unwound 32 times. Expected: verified; the library's inline run proved it in 6.2 s.
capabilities: regression proof of a record's method
